newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Mostly steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said.
Four barges traded versus one barge on Friday.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, traded at 150 percent of tariff.
- Two barges, Illinois River, this week, one barge bid at 145 percent of tariff, offer 150 percent.
- One barge, Mid-Mississippi, this week, bid 155 percent, down five percentage points from Friday, similar, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, no bid, offer 165 percent.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of May, bid one each week at 130 percent, unchanged, similar, offer 137-1/2 percent, no comparison.
